body.name: Coherent nuisance remainder with support leakage
body.construction:
Let
\[
 \kappa_{\mathrm{supp},n}
 =\frac{r_{A,\infty}+r_{Z,\infty}}{\tau_{S,n}},
\]
and set
\[
\begin{aligned}
 R_{\Sigma}={}&r_m+r_\pi+r_A+r_Z+r_f+r_w+r_W+r_B+r_d+r_D+r_R+r_N+r_h+r_G+r_b\\
 &+r_{A,\infty}+r_{Z,\infty}+r_{G,\infty}
 +\kappa_{\mathrm{supp},n}+\ell_{A,n}+\ell_{Z,n},\\
 \Delta_n={}&r_m(r_\pi+r_A+r_Z)+r_Ar_Z
 +(r_A+r_Z)R_{\Sigma}+\ell_{A,n}+\ell_{Z,n}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Here \(r_{A,\infty}\), \(r_{Z,\infty}\), and \(r_{G,\infty}\) are the foldwise essential-supremum errors of \(\widehat M_A\), \(\widehat M_Z\), and \(\widehat G\), respectively.  The term \(\kappa_{\mathrm{supp},n}=o_P(1)\) makes the support-screening event have probability tending to one, while \(\ell_{A,n}+\ell_{Z,n}\) records the first-order bias that can remain when an unrestricted fitted law puts mass in a true structural-zero cell.
